original.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.

decision.reason: [ev-f3d6519c3794] says Traefik v3 has removed support for the Kubernetes Ingress API group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 and tells users to switch to networking.k8s.io/v1. The environments exposed are the ones whose manifests still use Ingress at networking.k8s.io/v1beta1. That matches the proposed gvk-in-use condition, which is the standard shape for a removed API version. The validators were inconclusive, so they neither support nor contradict this condition.
